THE INSTRUMENT, and it is the payload -- the scored legs are the control. Two probes, added in this pair, read together and joined on frame=. [surf91] in vk/surface.c fires at #88's zeta decline and prints pg->frame_time. [clr91] in vk/draw.c fires when a requested clear is DROPPED because the binding it needed was absent -- zdrop for a requested depth clear with no zeta binding, cdrop for its colour twin -- and prints the same frame. pg->frame_time is monotonic, incremented once per flip (pgraph.c:2307), and each test in the suite flips once, so it partitions the run by test IN ORDER and a capture index maps onto it. r->current_frame cannot serve: it is a ring index over frames-in-flight and is reset to 0 (draw.c:3360).
